characteristics.why_it_costs_that: Broad athletic package.

characteristics.name: Built Strong

characteristics.why_it_costs_that: Front-seven physicality.

characteristics.name: Sure Tackler
characteristics.effect: TAK costs 18% less.
characteristics.why_it_costs_that: Core LB tool.

characteristics.effect: POW costs 15% less and TAK 10% less.
characteristics.why_it_costs_that: Premium physical package.

characteristics.name: Sideline-to-Sideline
characteristics.effect: PUR costs 15%, COD 10%, AGI 8% less.
characteristics.why_it_costs_that: Broad range package.

characteristics.name: Gap Shooter
characteristics.effect: ACC 8%, BSH 10%, PUR 10% cheaper.
characteristics.why_it_costs_that: Run-fit package.

characteristics.name: Block Destroyer
characteristics.effect: BSH costs 18% less.
characteristics.why_it_costs_that: Narrow front-seven skill.

characteristics.name: Coverage Instincts
characteristics.effect: MCV and ZCV cost 10% less.
characteristics.why_it_costs_that: Important coverage package.

characteristics.name: Route Recognition
characteristics.effect: PRC future upgrades cost 15% less and ZCV 8% less.
characteristics.why_it_costs_that: Mental/coverage.

characteristics.name: Ball Hawk
characteristics.effect: INT costs 15% less and CTH 10% less.
characteristics.why_it_costs_that: Premium turnover package.

characteristics.name: Pass Rush Bend
characteristics.effect: FMV costs 15% less and PUR 8% less.
characteristics.why_it_costs_that: Rush specialization.

characteristics.name: Power Rusher
characteristics.effect: PMV costs 15% less and BSH 8% less.
characteristics.why_it_costs_that: Rush specialization.

characteristics.name: Field General Mind
characteristics.effect: AWR and PRC future XP costs 15% less. If IQ is 125+, first defensive mental upgrade each season is 25% cheaper.
characteristics.why_it_costs_that: Strong IQ synergy.

characteristics.name: Run-Game Eraser
characteristics.effect: TAK, PUR and BSH each cost 8% less.
characteristics.why_it_costs_that: Broad run-stop package.

characteristics.name: Turnover Hunter
characteristics.effect: INT/CTH 8% cheaper; takeaway weekly challenge pays +1 bonus XP, max +1/week.
characteristics.why_it_costs_that: Conditional.

characteristics.name: Faster Developer
characteristics.effect: Earn +15% Player XP from all eligible sources. Dev-trait promotion challenge checks occur 50% more often until the player reaches X-Factor. Does not guarantee promotion; the challenge still must be completed.
characteristics.why_it_costs_that: Directly accelerates both ratings growth and access to development promotions, so it consumes half the build.

characteristics.name: Team Player
characteristics.effect: Team XP functionality is unlocked from Season 1. The player may convert his earned Player XP to Team XP at the normal 4:3 rate even before reaching his personal ceiling. XP already spent on teammates cannot be reclaimed.
characteristics.why_it_costs_that: Creates roster-wide value years earlier than normal.

characteristics.name: Great Negotiator
characteristics.effect: All REC Coin contract offers are increased by 20% after the normal contract-value calculation. Applies to Contracts II and III; Rookie Contract remains draft-slot based unless league configuration enables rookie negotiation bonuses.
characteristics.why_it_costs_that: Meaningful recurring economy bonus.

characteristics.name: Known Commodity
characteristics.effect: For Contracts II and III, the player's performance component can never produce an offer below the 'Elite' salary band. The contract engine values him as an established ceiling-level asset even after a poor contract window.
characteristics.why_it_costs_that: Removes most downside risk from the career economy.

characteristics.name: Competitive Drive
characteristics.effect: Completing at least 2 of the week's 3 weekly challenges gives the completed challenges' points a +5% bonus.
characteristics.why_it_costs_that: Requires performance rather than granting passive ratings.

characteristics.name: Film Junkie
characteristics.effect: Future AWR upgrades cost 20% less Player XP. Defensive players also receive 20% cheaper PRC upgrades. Does not change IQ-test results.
characteristics.why_it_costs_that: Permanent discount on highly valuable mental attributes.

characteristics.name: Generational Ceiling
characteristics.effect: Starting development trait is Star rather than Normal. The player is eligible for future Superstar/X-Factor promotion challenges through performance. No direct ratings are added.
characteristics.why_it_costs_that: A major career-long ceiling advantage.

characteristics.name: Complete Package
characteristics.effect: ALL attributes cost 5% less Player XP.
characteristics.why_it_costs_that: Broad, unconditional discount across every rating, available to every build regardless of branch; Progression Tree Tier 2, requires owning 2 Tier 1 perks first.

characteristics.name: Self-Made
characteristics.effect: Unlocks a direct Player-XP purchase that forces YOUR next development-trait promotion. The commissioner still replicates the trait in Madden.
characteristics.why_it_costs_that: The single biggest lever in the career economy, available to every build regardless of branch; Progression Tree Tier 3, requires any Tier 2 perk first.

characteristics.name: Personnel Chief
characteristics.effect: Unlocks the Trade Center for this franchise after the perk is purchased from the Progression Tree.
characteristics.why_it_costs_that: Opens player movement that is otherwise locked in Rise to Immortality, available to every build regardless of branch; Progression Tree Tier 2.

characteristics.name: Spotlight
characteristics.effect: Earn +10% Player XP from all eligible sources.
characteristics.why_it_costs_that: Permanent earn-rate bump on top of Origins perks, available to every build regardless of branch; Progression Tree Tier 3.

characteristics.name: Run Stuffer
characteristics.effect: BSH, TAK and PUR each cost 8% less Player XP.
characteristics.why_it_costs_that: Box LB identity; opens the Run Enforcer branch. Progression Tree Tier 2.

characteristics.name: Tone Setter
characteristics.effect: TAK, BSH and PRC each cost 10% less Player XP.
characteristics.why_it_costs_that: Deepens the Run Enforcer identity; Progression Tree Tier 3, requires Run Stuffer.

characteristics.name: Heart of the Defense
characteristics.effect: TAK, BSH, PRC and SPD each cost 8% less Player XP.
characteristics.why_it_costs_that: Run Enforcer capstone suite; Progression Tree Tier 4, requires Tone Setter.

characteristics.name: Coverage Range
characteristics.effect: SPD, ACC and AGI each cost 8% less Player XP.
characteristics.why_it_costs_that: Coverage LB athleticism; opens the Coverage Commander branch. Progression Tree Tier 2. Distinct from Origins' Sideline-to-Sideline -- same flavor, different key, so the two don't collide.

characteristics.name: Coverage Linebacker
characteristics.effect: ZCV, MCV and PRC each cost 8% less Player XP.
characteristics.why_it_costs_that: Deepens the Coverage Commander identity; Progression Tree Tier 3, requires Coverage Range.

characteristics.name: Coverage Commander
characteristics.effect: ZCV, MCV and PRC each cost 10% less Player XP.
characteristics.why_it_costs_that: Coverage Commander capstone suite; Progression Tree Tier 4, requires Coverage Linebacker.

characteristics.name: Havoc Threat
characteristics.effect: PMV and FMV each cost 12% less Player XP.
characteristics.why_it_costs_that: Pass-rush identity beyond Origins' rush perks; opens the Disruptor branch. Progression Tree Tier 2.

characteristics.name: Backfield Menace
characteristics.effect: PMV and FMV cost an additional 8% less; POW costs 10% less Player XP.
characteristics.why_it_costs_that: Deepens the Disruptor identity toward finishing plays; Progression Tree Tier 3, requires Havoc Threat.

characteristics.name: Disruptor
characteristics.effect: PMV, FMV and POW each cost 10% less Player XP.
characteristics.why_it_costs_that: Disruptor capstone suite; Progression Tree Tier 4, requires Backfield Menace.

characteristics.name: Coordinators Eye
characteristics.effect: AWR and PRC each cost 10% less Player XP.
characteristics.why_it_costs_that: Deepens the mental identity Field General Mind starts at Origins; opens the Defensive Field General branch. Progression Tree Tier 2.

characteristics.name: Pre-Snap Read
characteristics.effect: AWR costs an additional 8% less; PRC costs an additional 10% less Player XP.
characteristics.why_it_costs_that: Deepens the Defensive Field General identity; Progression Tree Tier 3, requires Coordinators Eye.

characteristics.name: Defensive Field General
characteristics.effect: AWR, PRC and TAK each cost 8% less Player XP.
characteristics.why_it_costs_that: Defensive Field General capstone suite; Progression Tree Tier 4, requires Pre-Snap Read.
